# dsh-custom-fonts
Customize the **Chinese** and **English** fonts, the **code font**, and the **global font size** of
the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — right from a settings page, with a live preview.
中文说明
## What it does
A pure client-side plugin (no host half, no restart needed). Once installed it adds a **Fonts (字体)**
page under **Settings**:

- **UI font · English** — used for Latin characters. (Segoe UI, Arial, Georgia, Consolas…)
- **UI fo

nt · Chinese** — used for Han characters. (微软雅黑 / 宋体 / 黑体 / 楷体 / 思源黑体 / 苹方…)
- **English glyph scale
** — 100–160 % slider that enlarges Latin glyphs only (no layout change), to balance mono CJK faces

that draw Han noticeably taller than Latin capitals (Maple Mono NL NF CN: ~23 %).
- **Code font** —
a separate mono face for code blocks and inline code (`pre`/`code`/`kbd`/`samp`). (Consolas, JetBrai

ns Mono, Fira Code, Cascadia Code, Sarasa Mono SC…)
- **Content font-size offset** — -4..+8 px, equi
valent to temporarily shifting the app's own font-size setting; body text, headings, tables and code

blocks all move together, no per-level cascade.
- **Live preview** — mixed Chinese/English UI sampl
e plus a code-font sample render as you type (comma-separated font lists and free-form names are bot

h supported).
- **Persistence** — fonts, scale and offset are stored in localStorage and replayed on

load, so a refresh keeps them without opening the settings page.
- **Reset** — clears every control
and removes all injected styles.
## How it works
The plugin injects one global stylesheet:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The font-family fallback chain is the standard way to split fonts by script: Latin characters matc
h the English font first, and Han characters — which the English font has no glyphs for — fall back

to the Chinese font. No language detection, no DOM surgery.
- The code-font rule comes later and win

s inside code regions only.
- The English glyph scale renders a Latin-only copy of the same local fo
nt through `@font-face` + `size-adjust`; Han glyphs are untouched. `unicode-range` deliberately excl
udes U+2000-206F / 3000-303F / FF00-FFEF so Chinese punctuation is not enlarged, and if `local()` ca

nnot resolve the face the @font-face simply never loads — the plain stack stays.
- The size offset r
ewrites the app's own content-size tokens. The theme declares `--dsh-content-font-size` and friends
on `<body>`, and descendants only reference those variables, so overriding font-size on arbitrary el
ements cannot reach them; the plugin writes concrete px values on body instead. The new value is the
body's original `--dsh-content-font-size` plus N, injected only while the offset is non-zero, and r
ecomputed when the app changes the body style — so both settings can be combined.
Changes apply immediately and globally (message body, sidebar, inputs, everything).
## Install
From the plugin market (Settings → **Plugin Market**) once the entry is published, or:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or directly from the repository:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Client-only plugin: after a page refresh it is live — no restart required.
## Uninstall
Remove it from **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration** (or `dsh plugin --profile web remove ds
h-custom-fonts`), refresh the page; your fonts are reverted automatically.

tence and the content font-size offset fix.
